mapper.select: SELECT Count(*) FROM emp WHERE DEL_STATUS = 0

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, a.* FROM ( SELECT EMP_NO , EMP_NAME , EMP_TEL , EMAIL , SAL , HIRE_DATE , GRADE_CODE , DEPT_CODE , DEL_STATUS , REGISTRAR , IN_DATE FROM EMP WHERE DEL_STATUS = 0
ORDER BY EMP_NO ASC ) a ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}

SELECT e1.EMP_NO, e1.EMP_NAME, e1.EMP_TEL, e1.EMAIL, e1.SAL, e1.HIRE_DATE, e1.GRADE_CODE, e1.DEPT_CODE, e1.DEL_STATUS, e1.REGISTRAR, e1.IN_DATE, e2.EMP_NAME AS REGISTRAR_NAME, d1.DEPT_NAME FROM EMP e1 LEFT JOIN EMP e2 ON e1.REGISTRAR = e2.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN DEPT d1 ON e1.DEPT_CODE = d1.DEPT_CODE WHERE e1.EMP_NO = #{empNo}
SELECT e.EMP_NO, e.EMP_NAME FROM EMP e WHERE e.EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND e.DEL_STATUS = 0

SELECT e.EMP_NO, e.EMP_NAME, e.EMP_TEL, e.EMAIL, e.HIRE_DATE, e.GRADE_CODE, e.DEPT_CODE, e.DEL_STATUS, img.EMP_FILENAME FROM EMP e LEFT JOIN EMP_IMAGE img ON e.EMP_NO = img.EMP_NO AND img.ORDER_NUM = 1 WHERE e.USERNAME = #{username} AND e.DEL_STATUS = 0 ORDER BY 1
SELECT -- c.MIDDLE_STATUS, TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.CONTEXT, '[^|]+', 1, 2)) AS SAL FROM COMMON c WHERE c.BIG_STATUS = 220 AND c.MIDDLE_STATUS = #{presetId}
SELECT c.MIDDLE_STATUS as defaultPresetId FROM COMMON c WHERE c.BIG_STATUS = 210 AND c.MIDDLE_STATUS = #{defaultGradeCode}

SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.CONTEXT, '[^|]+', 1, 2)) AS SALARY_AMT FROM COMMON g JOIN COMMON s ON s.MIDDLE_STATUS = g.MIDDLE_STATUS AND s.BIG_STATUS = 220 WHERE g.BIG_STATUS = 210 AND g.MIDDLE_STATUS = #{gradeCode} AND s.MIDDLE_STATUS = #{gradeCode}
SELECT MIDDLE_STATUS AS MIDDLE_STATUS, CONTEXT AS CONTEXT FROM COMMON WHERE BIG_STATUS = 200 AND MIDDLE_STATUS not in (999) ORDER BY MIDDLE_STATUS
